name: DOC_RAG_REPORT_BENCHMARK
description: A document-grounded retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) benchmark that evaluates systems on generating accurate, well-supported reports or answers from provided documents. It measures both retrieval quality (finding relevant passages) and generation faithfulness/factuality when producing document-based reports. Designed to stress test end-to-end RAG pipelines on document understanding and answer generation.
reputation: A niche Hugging Face dataset for evaluating document-grounded RAG systems; useful to researchers working on retrieval+generation but not widely adopted outside that community.
